proposed_from.topic: Sharp identifying-degree frontier for rationally identifiable acyclic linear Gaussian mixed graphs with directed indegree at most two. Let ID_G be the source-defined minimum, over recursive identifying orders, of the largest total polynomial degree in any certificate, and let D2(n) maximize ID_G over identifiable n-vertex graphs. Prove matching asymptotic upper and lower bounds for D2(n), including an explicit graph family whose degree cannot be reduced by recursive substitutions through structural or error parameters; compile the upper bound into a total stopping schedule for DegBoundedIdentifiability; and give plug-in influence-function and simultaneous Wald inference for the returned rational formulas on fixed denominator, covariance-eigenvalue, and nondegeneracy charts. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact rank-intersection closure over all original parameters was derived and used to enumerate all 64 topologically labelled three-vertex mixed graphs, yielding D2(3)=3: eight degree-one, twenty-one degree-two, two degree-three, and thirty-three generically rank-deficient graphs. A positive-definite six-vertex directed chain outside HTC was constructed; two quadratic cycle equations with distinct second roots cancel to give a rational certificate of degree at most nine. Checks covered bow nonidentification, cycle ambiguity, error-parameter shortcuts, generic-elimination collapse, and current tree-identification work; no exact frontier collision was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Determine the sharp graph-uniform closure degree for every rationally identifiable indegree-two graph and construct a matching family whose degree-d closure remains proper below that threshold. EARLY KILL TEST: Compute exact degree-four closure for the six-vertex two-triangle graph, including error parameters; if it is complete, abandon cycle length as growth evidence and test constant-degree completeness before enlarging the family. seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction; Definition of \(ID_G\); Corollary 4.5; Theorem 5.1; Conclusion, final paragraph
seed_details.opportunity: Determine the sharp asymptotic scale of \(D_2(n)\) and match it with an explicit order-independent lower family.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the supplied cutoff in Theorem 5.1 by a graph-uniform closure theorem, then replace displayed-resultant degree by an intrinsic invariant stable under adjoining any earlier structural or disturbance coordinate.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches pairing acyclic indegree two with recursive certificate degree, birational inverse degree, and graph-uniform rational identification found bounded-degree search, general inverse-map bounds, and tree-only cycle algorithms, but no occupied frontier theorem.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say bounded indegree makes the source algorithm's degree bound immediate.
seed_details.rebuttal: The source proves degree at most five or thirty-six only on HTC, instrumental-cutset, or auxiliary-cutset subclasses and explicitly leaves global growth open; no completeness theorem follows from indegree two.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The focal object is the minimum recursive degree over every order and all original parameters, not the degree of one expanded formula or a do-calculus effect functional.

seed_details.anchor_location: Equations (2)--(3), Composition and Elimination, Lemmas 8, 12--13, Lemma 25, and Theorem 27
seed_details.opportunity: Prove an if-and-only-if finite obstruction classification showing that one absolute degree closes every rationally identifiable indegree-two graph.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the tree proof's equation with exactly two scalar indeterminates by a complete classification of finite correspondences between two-parent coefficient blocks.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for missing-cycle completeness, two-parent bilinear block propagation, and constant-degree rational identification found only the directed-tree classification and its faster implementation.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may call this TreeID with two-vector nodes.
seed_details.rebuttal: A missing covariance equation now involves up to four structural coefficients, so Möbius propagation, the unicyclic component argument, and the two-root conclusion all fail at the first algebraic step.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The degree-four computation for \(K_6\) is a mandatory kill test; the seed is abandoned if exact closure already contradicts its finite-obstruction route.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1, Appendix A.6 pairwise elimination proof, Theorem 2, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Determine the sharp minimum recursive degree on rationally identifiable directed-tree models before enlarging the lower family to indegree two.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Turn the product of missing-edge Möbius matrices from an upper construction into a valuation or Newton-polytope lower bound valid over every cycle choice and disturbance-parameter substitution.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches found tree fiber-cardinality completeness and faster cycle detection, but no theorem for the minimum source-defined certificate degree as cycle length grows.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say linear expression growth follows immediately by multiplying \(2\times2\) transfer matrices.
seed_details.rebuttal: Matrix multiplication only upper-bounds one displayed certificate; the missing result is a minimum-degree lower bound over every recursive structural and error order.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is a fallback lower-bound laboratory, not a claim that the indegree-two frontier equals the tree frontier.

seed_details.opportunity: Exhibit singleton generic fibers at indegree two with arbitrarily large minimum rational inverse degree, separating uniqueness from formula complexity.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the tree theorem's one, two, or infinite fiber trichotomy by an LSEM-realizable birational map whose inverse multidegree is intrinsically large.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: General birational maps with large inverse degree exist, but searches found no acyclic indegree-two covariance realization or recursive-order lower bound.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may invoke standard high-degree Cremona inverses.
seed_details.rebuttal: Arbitrary Cremona maps do not satisfy the acyclic covariance factorization, support restrictions, positive-definite chart, or recursive certificate convention.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: A single tuned covariance does not count; the separation must be generic on a nonempty regular region.

seed_details.opportunity: Bound recursive identifying degree by an explicit function of the treewidth of the parameter-equation incidence graph and prove a matching realizable lower bound.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pathwise pair elimination by separator elimination while preserving minimum inverse degree rather than presentation degree.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Sparse-elimination and treewidth results bound intermediate systems, but searches found no recursive rational-certificate theorem for linear SEM covariance ideals.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may call the result standard sparse-elimination folklore.
seed_details.rebuttal: Standard bounds concern a chosen elimination presentation; the lower match must survive alternative recursive orders and be realized by supported covariance equations.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The named focal object is a parameterized degree frontier, not generic runtime folklore.

seed_details.opportunity: Classify a strict super-class of directed trees using projective transfers between two-parent coefficient blocks.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Aggregate enough missing-covariance equations to define a generically finite projective correspondence before composing transfers.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for matrix-pencil, projective-transfer, and two-parent SEM identification found no target-method match.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say a hand-built subclass avoids the graph-uniform question.
seed_details.rebuttal: The subclass is retained only if it contains every directed tree and a genuinely two-parent outside-HTC family with a proved strict inclusion.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The inclusion relation to the published tree class is part of the deliverable.

seed_details.anchor_location: Algorithm 1, Theorem 5.1, implementation discussion, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Compile a valid graph-uniform bound into a terminating exact formula-returning procedure.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the user-supplied \(d\) and wall-clock timeout by a proved structural cutoff and a complete exact negative transcript.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Dörfler et al. supply a total generic-identification decision but no rational formulas; no located procedure combines totality with minimum-degree formula output on indegree two.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say the schedule is immediate once the frontier is known.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the mathematical kernel, so the schedule is retained only as a compiled theorem and never ranked as the proposal's independent contribution.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is explicitly downgraded from kernel status.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 7, Proposition 9, Proposition 12, Remark 8, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Among rational certificates equal on the covariance model, characterize the first-order variance-minimizing off-model representative and its efficiency frontier.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project ambient gradients of equivalent rational representatives onto the covariance-model tangent space before optimizing the remaining normal component.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches found witness-dependent HTC variances and symbolic minimum-degree formulas, but no joint optimization of formula degree and influence variance over equivalent representatives.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say equal rational functionals necessarily have equal derivatives.
seed_details.rebuttal: Only tangential derivatives agree on the model variety; empirical covariance fluctuates in ambient normal directions, where different representatives and HTC witnesses can have different variance.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is an efficiency-bound seed, not a bare delta-method appendix.

seed_details.anchor_location: Definition 1.2, Theorems 1.8--1.9, proof recurrence, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize intrinsic inverse-Jacobian restrictions that are sufficient and close to necessary for uniform concentration of degree-bounded rational recovery.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pathwise denominator induction by a formula-independent smallest-singular-value bound for the covariance inverse map.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches found bow-free sufficient stability and an ill-conditioned four-node path, but no indegree-two rational-chart characterization tied to symbolic formula output.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may say denominator and covariance-eigenvalue margins already guarantee stability.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those margins do not bound the inverse Jacobian or high-degree coefficient growth, and the published four-node construction separates identification from conditioning.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The chart restriction is intrinsic and the failure side must hold on a nondegenerate sequence, not at one singular law.

seed_details.anchor_location: Section 5 examples, computational study, proof of the HTC results, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Compute exact recursive-degree tables through the smallest non-tree cases with analytic witnesses for every attained degree.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Refine graph-level rational-identification enumeration to the rank-intersection closure over all original coordinates and all degrees below the first success.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Published censuses report identification classes and fibers, but not source-defined recursive formula degree.
seed_details.red_team: A referee may dismiss this as a finite computer-algebra catalogue.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds as a standalone paper, so the census is used only for falsification, base cases, and reproducible lower certificates.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: No flagship claim is attached to enumeration alone.
